decision_chains: Epistemic score must answer contextual understanding, not just factual correctness
Six weighted components: summary_confidence(0.20), validation_status(0.15), neighbor_coverage(0.20), cross_reference_density(0.15), enrichment_depth(0.15), staleness_check(0.15)
14b validation worth 1.0, 3b self-validation worth 0.6, unvalidated worth 0.0
Isolated nodes (0 neighbors) get neutral 0.5 on neighbor_coverage, not penalized
Cross-reference density uses sigmoid with diminishing returns after 4 references
Staleness is strongest negative signal: hash mismatch = 0.0 score component
Score decay propagates max 3 hops with decreasing severity
Nodes with epistemic_score < 0.95 enter re-enrichment priority queue
Epistemic scores should be embedded in trace_epistemic.jsonl as computed field, not separate file
Time decay proposed at 0.98/day after 30 days, with open question about aggressiveness
Module synthesis should produce module-level epistemic scores
Failed augmentation attempts capped at 3, then marked augmentation_blocked
